subject: abundance and variance estimates for sub-regions in dsm

messages.subject: abundance and variance estimates for sub-regions in dsm
parts:
Hello,

I am using dsm to estimate predicted abundance of birds across certain area, based on transect counts. Then, I need to get estimates across some sub-regions of this study area. I guess that I can, probably, estimate abundance by simply summing predicted values in grid cells withing each sub-region, but how do I estimate variance for each of sub-regions?

I understand, it can be done in Distance, but what about dsm?

Thank you,

Mikhail
